versions.subject: rules: more sliver rules
versions.detection:
selection_id:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
selection1:
    ImagePath|re: '^[a-zA-Z]:\\windows\\temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{10}\.exe'
selection2:
    ServiceName: 
        - 'Sliver'
        - 'Sliver implant'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: | rex field=ImagePath "(?<ImagePathMatch>^[a-zA-Z]:\\\\windows\\\\temp\\\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{10}\\.exe)" | eval ImagePathCondition=if(isnotnull(ImagePathMatch), "true", "false") | search (Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID=7045) OR ImagePathCondition="true" OR ServiceName IN ("Sliver", "Sliver implant")
